qGloss.zh: 说一个你喜欢去的地方，为什么喜欢？

rubric: Names a place and gives at least one reason in two or more connected sentences; mostly correct simple tenses.

q: Some people prefer to work alone, others in a team. Which do you prefer, and why?

qGloss.zh: 有人喜欢独自工作，有人喜欢团队合作。你更喜欢哪一种？为什么？

rubric: States a preference and supports it with at least two reasons or an example, in three or more sentences with some complex structures.
